- *Images in a picture element.* Docket told a site to wrap its photos in a
  picture element with a WebP source and the JPEG as the fallback, and then still
  reported the fallback JPEG as an old-format image, so following the advice did
  not clear the finding. An image whose picture offers a WebP or AVIF source, or
  whose srcset names only such files, is no longer counted. A picture of JPEG
  sources, and a plain JPEG, still are.
